verdict.rationale: smolagents docs describe agent memory as inspectable/replayable and expose step callbacks that let developers dynamically modify the agent's memory (docs-7, docs-8), which can be used to trim or filter conversation history, but there is no built-in summarization, automatic truncation, or context-window management feature documented. missing for 10: dedicated context-window/summarization API, automatic history trimming, independent evidence of developers using callbacks for this exact purpose.
